summary: Nicola Mining Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications. The filing reports routine quarterly results, including a net loss, cash position of C$10.2 million, and asset retirement obligations. No merger, acquisition, tender, or strategic transaction is announced. The filing is a periodic report by a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation.
